en: The postcard depicts a functionalist-style modernist building, featuring clean lines and rectangular forms, typical of early to mid-20th century architecture. The photo is black and white, suggesting it is from the earlier half of the 20th century. The building has the large letters 'SOK' on the facade. There is clear signage on the image itself with the words 'Kotka' (bottom left) and 'S.O.K' (bottom right). The street appears quiet, and the overall scene exudes an official or business-like atmosphere.
